supplied_and_used.role: Plate I, the vision. Cover and scenes 2 to 4 of the opening.
supplied_and_used.shows: Three women tend a towering golden dandelion on a hillside above the sea: one kneels over a map, one looks up at the seed head, one ties a timber support to the stem. Roots in red earth, thatched houses, mountains, the sea.
supplied_and_used.source: Sent by the founder on 2026-11-17. Stored exactly as received; not re-encoded.

supplied_and_used.role: Plate II, the table. Scene 5 of the opening, the partners section, the resources section.
supplied_and_used.shows: Two women, a schoolgirl with a slate and a young woman with folded cloth at a timber table around a map held down by river stones, with a compass and a small potted dandelion. A man reaches for a book on cedar shelves; a brass scale and a ruler sit on a shelf; arches open onto the sea and two dhows. A sandstone pillar fills the left edge.
supplied_and_used.source: Sent by the founder on 2026-11-17. Stored exactly as received; not re-encoded.

supplied_and_used.role: Plate IV on the page, the veranda at dusk. The about section (the ledge) and the closing.
supplied_and_used.shows: An empty stone veranda at dusk: folded cloth on a dark ledge, arches over palms and the sea, two dhows, a lit brass lantern and one dandelion seed on the wall.
supplied_and_used.source: Sent by the founder on 2026-11-17. Stored exactly as received; not re-encoded.

supplied_and_used.role: Plate III on the page, planting. The approach section.
supplied_and_used.shows: Two women plant a dandelion seed in a terracotta bowl. The far-left background is a hill town with a dome, an aqueduct and cypress trees, which reads as Italian; the page frames that part out.
supplied_and_used.source: Sent by the founder on 2026-11-17. Stored exactly as received; not re-encoded.

supplied_not_used.name: Veranda panorama
supplied_not_used.shows: A wide veranda: five women at a map table, a carved pillar, shelves with botanical prints, a bench with a brass scale, a slate, a balustrade, a palm, the sea at dusk and a lantern.
supplied_not_used.why_not: It is 667 pixels tall, it repeats scenes that the sharper 16:9 paintings already carry, and its figures are a different cast. Not stored in this folder.

made_for_this_site.what: A lighter copy of each painting, 1100 x 619 pixels, WebP quality 72, resized from the supplied file. Browsers choose it for small, low-density windows.
Three halftone figures (the taproot, the stem, the seed head) drawn entirely in code and printed in the browser. Original work for this site; no image files.
Drawn on top of the paintings, never into them: a few dandelion seeds, a gold ring, a gold box around a shelf, a soft glow at the lantern.
